programs.description: Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.
Viswanathan, a loyal home minister, sincerely works for the welfare of the people. However, he faces many challenges when he encounters an evil politician, Natarajan.
Harinarayanan, a young man who works in Chennai, is in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich couple. However, he and his family are forced to bear the burden of tradition.
Odayil Ninnu
Sajna rejects the love of her college mate, Ameer, as she is already engaged to her cousin Anwar. However, Sajna's marriage with Anwar gets cancelled due to an unexpected turn of events.
Saint Rakthabhisha transforms into Ravi Chandra to get married. Soon, one of his disciples helps defeat rival Sriganda and unite Ravi with Rajyalakshmi.
Kuriakose engages in a relationship with a woman but later marries someone else. Years later, Rajan, Kuriakose's son, seeks revenge on him for abandoning his mother.
A family has to deal with the fact that the father, who is also the one that holds the family together, has developed Alzheimer's disease.
A violinist enters a marriage that promises security, only to face heartbreak as love, illness and time reshape everything he once believed was under control.
Documentary filmmaker Aleena delves into the mysterious disappearance of the yesteryear Malayalam actress, Gracy, from the silver screen.

Vishnu, a policeman, leads a happy life with his wife, Gayathri, until he is murdered in cold blood, and she is raped. However, she vows revenge and returns with a new identity to punish the culprits.
A youngster attends a bachelor party in an attempt to get rid of his sickening wife and then, he sets off on an adventurous journey after reuniting with his childhood friend and the school teacher.
Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.
Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.

Meera arrives at brothers Chathukutty Bhagavathar and Chandappan Gurukkal's house claiming to be the Bhagavathar's daughter. However, another man reaches the village and insists that he is her father.
A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.
Parthasarathy is well-loved by the people around him as he constantly works for their welfare. Soon, he falls in love with the daughter of his rival, unaware that she has an ulterior motive.
Rajan is in love with his cousin Sumithra, and he tries many ways to ruin her marriage proposals. However, he is in for a rude shock when a man gets ready to marry her even after blackmailing him.
The Kauravas and Pandavas, two rival families, battle for supremacy in Hastinapur. With Krishna's support, the Pandavas strive to emerge victorious.
Franco, who runs an automobile workshop, and his sister Jenny, a college student, share a very strong bond. Matters take a turn when Franco falls in love with Jenny's enemy.
